Messages.Author: Jason Mowat
Messages.Body:
Greets again!

I have read some posts and am now a little confused about directed actions.
Can a directed action only be targeted against your prey? If you have a
bleed action card with a 'D' on it, you can only use that card against your
prey? Or can you use it against your predator, if you wish?

Thanks,
Jason

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jason Mowat wrote:
>
> Greets again!
>
> I have read some posts and am now a little confused about directed actions.
> Can a directed action only be targeted against your prey?

Any action can be targetted against any legal targets, as defined on
the card or in the rules.

An action can only be classified as directed (or not) *after* the target
is known, not the other way around.

> If you have a
> bleed action card with a 'D' on it, you can only use that card against your
> prey? Or can you use it against your predator, if you wish?

Bleeds are directed at one's prey by default.
See the rulebook, section 6.1.1 and 6.1.6
